## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4008. The issue was that the nginx-ingress controller v1.12.1, which was deployed over the weekend, has snippet annotations disabled (`allow-snippet-annotations=false`). This breaks the legacy-portal Ingress resource's regex-based redirects that use the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation with capture groups to redirect `/old/...` URLs to `/portal/...`.

**Key evidence:** The ingress controller logs clearly show the warning: "skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled."

**Fix:** The platform team should enable snippet annotations by setting `allow-snippet-annotations=true` in the ingress-nginx controller deployment/configuration to restore the regex redirect functionality.
